description: Apply the engineering standards as a new-project design checklist — separation-of-concerns boundaries, a C4 context plus one flow diagram, the initial ADR set, a /docs skeleton, and a dependency policy note.
outputs: NNNN-slug.md ADRs for every load-bearing call, an architecture sketch with diagrams, and a /docs skeleton

description: Audit a design, component or diff against every loaded principle and roll the findings into a severity-graded report — BLOCKER and MAJOR must be resolved or ADR-justified, MINOR defers to the backlog.
outputs: severity-graded findings report with an executive summary

description: Weigh a decision in play against the principles it puts in tension, recommend an option, and record the choice as a numbered ADR.
